newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist-Broc targets 10 pct annual growth.
newsitem.headline: Gist-Broc targets 10 pct annual growth.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV aims to achieve 10 percent average annual growth in both turnover and earnings, chairman Herman Scheffer told reporters on Wednesday.
"We want to achieve average annual growth of 10 percent in both turnover and profit over the years," he said.

Scheffer said he considered this goal as ambitious, given Gist-Brocades' dependence upon penicillin prices. He said Gist intended to grow both organically and through acquisitions, with both factors contributing equally to growth.
Scheffer expected antibiotics prices to show a clear drop during the first half of this year until supply and demand came more into balance in the second half.
This would put pressure on results in the company's industrial pharmaceutical products division where Gist expects 1997 operating profit to be about equal to last year's.
The other two divisions, bakery ingredients and food specialities, are expected to post higher profits during the current year, Scheffer said.
Gist-Brocades earlier said 1996 net profit had risen by 10 percent to 158.5 million guilders.
